```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Load packages and config}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

source(here::here("analysis", "0-config.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "0-functions.R"))
```

```{r Load data}

dist_summ <- readRDS(here("data", "district_ATE_means.rds"))

dist_rand_summ <- readRDS(here("data", "district_mortality_means_by_randomization_arm.rds"))
dist_tx_summ <- readRDS(here("data", "district_mortality_means_by_treatment_group.rds"))

niger_adm2_sub <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))
niger_adm2_sub <- niger_adm2_sub %>%
  left_join(dist_summ, by = c("adm2_name" = "district"))

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data.rds"))
csi_dat_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "csi_dat.rds"))

ate_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "preds_ATE.rds")) 

```

```{r Supp table 1}

mort_ci_tbl <- dist_tx_summ %>%
  mutate(MortRate_CI = sprintf("%.1f (95%% CI: %.1f, %.1f)", MortRate, MortRate_CI_low, MortRate_CI_high)) %>%
  dplyr::select(district, isTreated_child, MortRate_CI) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = isTreated_child, values_from = MortRate_CI, names_prefix = "MortRate_")

dist_summ <- dist_summ %>%
  mutate(ATE_CI = sprintf("%.1f (95%% CI: %.1f, %.1f)", ATE, ATE_CI_low, ATE_CI_high))

dist_summ %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("MortRate")) %>%
  left_join(mort_ci_tbl, by = "district") %>%
  arrange(desc(ATE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(district, ends_with("_Treatment"), ends_with("_Control"), ATE_CI) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

```


```{r Supp fig 1}

districts <- dist_summ %>%
  arrange(desc(ATE)) %>%
  pull(district) %>%
  (\(x) c("Overall", x[x != "Overall"]))()

ctrl_mort <- dist_tx_summ %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTreated_child == "Control") %>%
  dplyr::select(district, MortRate_mean) %>%
  rename(ctrl_mort = MortRate_mean)

mort_ci_dat <- bind_rows(
  dist_rand_summ,
  dist_tx_summ %>% rename(tx = isTreated_child)
) %>%
  left_join(ctrl_mort, by = "district") %>%
  dplyr::filter(tx != "Child Azithro") %>%
  mutate(tx = case_when(
    tx == "Infant Azithro" ~ "Control: Infant Azithro",
    tx == "Placebo" ~ "Control: Placebo",
    tx == "Control" ~ "**Control**",
    tx == "Treatment" ~ "**Treatment**",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  tx = factor(tx, 
              levels = c("Control: Infant Azithro", "Control: Placebo", "**Control**", "**Treatment**"),
              ordered = TRUE),
  district = factor(district, levels = districts, ordered = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(data = mort_ci_dat, aes(y = tx, x = MortRate, group = tx, color = tx)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = ctrl_mort), linetype = "dashed", color = "#8B174DFF", size = 0.3) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = MortRate_CI_low, xmax = MortRate_CI_high), 
                width = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control: Infant Azithro" = "#DA9FB8FF", 
                                "Control: Placebo" = "#C1447EFF", 
                                "**Control**" = "#8B174DFF", 
                                "**Treatment**" = "#6E8537FF")) +
  labs(y = "Department", x = "Mortality rate (deaths per 1000 py)") +
  xlim(c(0, 30)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y   = ggtext::element_markdown(lineheight = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ district, nrow = 3) +
  guides(color = "none")

ggsave(
  last_plot(),
  filename = here("results", "manuscript", "supp_fig1-district_mortality_rates.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```


```{r Supp Fig 2}

dist_summ %>%
  arrange(desc(ATE)) %>%
  mutate(dist_txt = paste0("**", district, "**<br>", ATE_CI),
    dist_txt = factor(dist_txt, levels = dist_txt),
    dist_txt = fct_relevel(dist_txt, paste0("**Overall**<br>", ATE_CI[district == "Overall"]), after = Inf)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = dist_txt, x = ATE)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ATE_CI_low, xmax = ATE_CI_high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(y = "Department", x = "Average Treatment Effect (deaths per 1000 py)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(lineheight = 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 5, by = 5))

ggsave(
  last_plot(),
  filename = here("results", "manuscript", "supp_fig2-district_ATEs.png"),
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r Supp fig 3}

base_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true", 
                         height = unit(0.7, "cm"), width = unit(0.7, "cm"),
                         pad_y = unit(0.7, "cm"), 
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(line_width = 0.5, 
                                                                fill = c("white", "grey40"),
                                                                text_col = "grey40",
                                                                line_col = "grey40")) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)
  )

csi_dat <- csi_dat_raw %>%
  st_transform(crs = global_crs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1], lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2])

csi_loc <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = csi_dat, aes(x = lon, y = lat), color = "#00695C", size = 0.5)

n <- dplyr::n_distinct(df_all$csi)
pastel_colors <- paletteer::paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Pastel") |> as.character()

csi_grappe_loc <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = csi), size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = csi_dat, aes(x = lon, y = lat), color = "black", size = 1, shape = 18) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorRampPalette(pastel_colors)(n)) +
  guides(color = "none")

ggsave(
  csi_grappe_loc,
  filename = here("results", "manuscript", "supp_fig3-csi_grappe_locations.png"),
  width = 4,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```


```{r Supp Fig 4 prep}

mod_rr_pred <- ate_preds %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig_int") %>%
    dplyr::select(geometry, rate_ratio)

mod_rr_pred_rast <- make_raster_map(mod_rr_pred, proj_crs, global_crs, "rate_ratio")
mod_rr_pred_df <- as.data.frame(mod_rr_pred_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

```

```{r Supp Fig 4}

model_rr <- base_map +
    geom_raster(data = mod_rr_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = rate_ratio), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "grey20", size = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = muted("#009392FF"), 
                            mid = "white", 
                            high = muted("#D0587EFF"), 
                         transform = "log",
                            midpoint = 1, 
                            limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
                            na.value = NA,
                            breaks = seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.25),
                            guide=guide_colorbar(title="Modeled mortality rate ratio", 
                                            title.position = "top",
                                            title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            label.position = "bottom",
                                            label.hjust = 0.5,
                                            barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                            barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                            ticks.colour = "white",
                                            ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                            frame.colour = "white"))

model_rr

ggsave(filename = here("results", "manuscript", "supp_fig4-modeled_ATE_rate_ratios.png"),
       plot = model_rr,
       width = 4,
       height = 4.5,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)

```
